academics.title: Academics
academics.subtitle: Explore our curriculum, teaching methodologies, and specialized educational programs for deaf and mute students

curriculum.title: Curriculum Overview
curriculum.description: Our curriculum is specifically designed to meet the unique learning needs of deaf and mute students. We follow the Maharashtra State Board curriculum with an emphasis on visual learning techniques, sign language instruction, and hands-on experiences. Our approach ensures that every student gains the knowledge and skills they need to reach their full potential.
curriculum.subjectsList: Marathi, English, Mathematics, Science, Social Studies, Sign Language, Vocational Training, Arts & Crafts, Physical Education

primary.title: Primary (Classes 1-4)
primary.description: At the primary level, we focus on foundational literacy, numeracy skills, and sign language communication. Students learn through visual aids, interactive activities, and hands-on learning. Our teachers provide individualized attention to build a strong foundation for each child.
primary.focus: Foundational literacy, Numeracy skills, Sign language foundation, Visual learning, Social skills development

middle.title: Middle (Classes 5-7)
middle.description: At the middle level, students explore more advanced concepts and develop critical thinking skills. The curriculum places greater emphasis on science, mathematics, and language studies, while also incorporating vocational training and life skills.
middle.focus: Advanced literacy, Mathematical reasoning, Scientific concepts, Social studies, Introduction to vocational skills

secondary.title: Secondary (Classes 8-10)
secondary.description: At the secondary level, students prepare for state board examinations. We provide in-depth knowledge across all subjects with an emphasis on vocational training and career guidance. Our students are well-prepared for higher education or vocational training.
secondary.focus: Board exam preparation, Advanced subject knowledge, Vocational training, Career guidance, Independent living skills

methodology.title: Teaching Methodology
methodology.description: Our teaching methodology is specifically designed for the unique learning needs of deaf and mute students. We use visual learning, sign language instruction, and assistive technology to create an inclusive and effective learning environment.

signLanguage.title: Sign Language Instruction
signLanguage.description: Sign language is the foundation of our teaching. All teachers are trained in Indian Sign Language (ISL) and use sign language in all classes. Students receive comprehensive training in sign language communication, grammar, and expression.

visualLearning.title: Visual Learning Techniques
visualLearning.description: We use visual aids, diagrams, videos, and interactive multimedia to clarify concepts and enhance understanding. Our classrooms are equipped with visual learning tools that make information accessible and engaging.

assistiveTech.title: Assistive Technology
assistiveTech.description: Our school is equipped with modern assistive technology, including hearing aids, FM systems, visual alert systems, and educational software. This technology helps students fully participate in their learning experience.

individualized.title: Individualized Attention
individualized.description: We maintain small class sizes so that each student can receive individualized attention. Teachers adapt to each child's learning pace and customize teaching strategies to meet their specific needs.

calendar.title: Academic Calendar
calendar.description: Our academic year begins in June and ends in March. We follow the Maharashtra State Board academic calendar with regular assessments, examinations, and holidays.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.subtitle: Explore our modern infrastructure designed specifically for deaf and mute students

library.title: Library
library.description: Our well-stocked library features a wide collection of books, visual learning materials, and digital resources. The library is designed with visual aids and sign language support to make reading accessible and enjoyable for all students.

labs.title: Science & Computer Labs
labs.description: State-of-the-art science and computer laboratories equipped with modern equipment and assistive technology. Our labs emphasize hands-on learning and visual demonstrations to make complex concepts easy to understand.

visualLearning.title: Visual Learning Labs
visualLearning.description: Specialized labs equipped with interactive whiteboards, projectors, and multimedia systems. These labs use visual teaching methods, animations, and videos to enhance learning for deaf and mute students.

assistiveTech.title: Assistive Technology Room
assistiveTech.description: A dedicated room with hearing aids, FM systems, visual alert systems, and specialized educational software. This technology helps students fully participate in their learning experience and communicate effectively.

classrooms.title: Spacious Classrooms
classrooms.description: Bright, well-ventilated classrooms with visual aids, sign language charts, and modern teaching equipment. Small class sizes ensure every student receives individualized attention from our trained teachers.

sports.title: Sports Facilities
sports.description: A large playground and sports facilities for physical education and recreational activities. We encourage students to participate in sports to develop physical fitness, teamwork, and confidence.

transport.title: Transport Services
transport.description: Safe and reliable school bus services covering nearby villages and towns. Our buses are equipped with safety features and trained staff to ensure students travel comfortably and securely.

cctv.title: CCTV Surveillance
cctv.description: Comprehensive CCTV coverage throughout the campus for student safety and security. Our security systems ensure a safe learning environment for all students and staff.

communicationSupport.title: Communication Support Systems
communicationSupport.description: Visual alert systems, sign language interpreters, and communication boards throughout the campus. These systems ensure that deaf and mute students can communicate effectively and access information easily.

admissions.title: Admissions
admissions.subtitle: Join our school community and give your child the gift of quality education

step1.title: Step 1: Enquiry
step1.description: Fill out the enquiry form on our website or visit the school office to learn more about our programs and admission requirements.

step2.title: Step 2: School Visit
step2.description: Schedule a visit to tour our facilities, meet our teachers, and observe our specialized teaching methods for deaf and mute students.

step3.title: Step 3: Application
step3.description: Download and complete the admission form. Submit it along with all required documents to the school office.

step4.title: Step 4: Assessment
step4.description: Your child will undergo a simple assessment to understand their learning needs and determine the appropriate class level.

step5.title: Step 5: Admission Confirmation
step5.description: Once accepted, complete the admission formalities, pay the fees, and receive the admission confirmation letter.

eligibility.title: Eligibility Criteria
eligibility.description: We welcome students who meet the following criteria:
eligibility.criteria1: Students with hearing impairment (deaf) or speech impairment (mute)
eligibility.criteria2: Age-appropriate for the class level (as per Maharashtra State Board guidelines)
eligibility.criteria3: Medical certificate confirming hearing or speech impairment
eligibility.criteria4: Transfer certificate from previous school (if applicable)
eligibility.criteria5: Willingness to learn and adapt to our specialized teaching methods

documents.title: Required Documents
documents.description: Please prepare the following documents for admission:
documents.doc2: Medical certificate confirming hearing or speech impairment
documents.doc3: Aadhar card of student and parent/guardian
documents.doc5: Transfer certificate from previous school (if applicable)
documents.doc8: Income certificate (for fee concession, if applicable)
documents.doc9: Address proof (electricity bill, ration card, etc.)

form.title: Admission Form
form.description: Download the admission form, fill it out completely, and submit it to the school office along with all required documents.

cta.title: Ready to Apply?
cta.description: Take the first step towards your child's bright future. Contact us today to begin the admission process.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Learn about our school's journey, values, and commitment to excellence

history.title: Our History
history.content: Savitribai Phule School for Deaf and Mute was established with a vision to provide quality education to deaf and mute students in rural Maharashtra. Located in Thalner Village, Shirpur, Dhule, our school has been serving the community for years, breaking barriers and creating opportunities for students with hearing and speech challenges. Our journey began with a small group of dedicated educators who believed that every child deserves access to quality education, regardless of their physical abilities.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To be a leading educational institution that empowers deaf and mute students to achieve their full potential and become confident, independent individuals who contribute meaningfully to society.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To provide comprehensive, accessible, and inclusive education through specialized teaching methodologies, sign language instruction, and assistive technology, ensuring that every student receives personalized attention and support to excel academically and socially.

inclusivity.title: Inclusivity
inclusivity.description: We believe in creating an environment where every student feels valued, respected, and included.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: We strive for the highest standards in education, teaching methodologies, and student outcomes.

empowerment.title: Empowerment
empowerment.description: We empower our students with skills, knowledge, and confidence to overcome challenges and succeed.

compassion.title: Compassion
compassion.description: We approach every student with understanding, patience, and genuine care for their well-being.

principal.title: Principal's Message
principal.name: Principal Name
principal.message: Dear Parents and Students, it is my privilege to welcome you to Savitribai Phule School for Deaf and Mute. Our school is more than just an educational institution; it is a community where every child is celebrated for their unique abilities. We are committed to providing a nurturing environment where deaf and mute students can thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. Our dedicated team of educators uses innovative teaching methods, including sign language instruction and visual learning techniques, to ensure that every student receives the support they need to succeed. Together, we are building a brighter future for our students, one where they can achieve their dreams and make meaningful contributions to society.
